name: detectiteasy
description: PE/ELF packer, compiler, and obfuscation detection toolkit

die.description: GUI packer detector with signature database and entropy analysis
die.usage:
die malware.exe # Interactive GUI analysis with detailed results
die --scan=all --json suspicious.dll > analysis.json # Full scan with JSON export
die --db-path=custom.db sample.bin # Use custom signature database
die --scan=entropy,heuristic packed.exe # Multiple scan types
die --recursive --mask=*.exe samples/ # Batch recursive scanning

diec.description: Console packer detector for automated malware analysis pipelines
diec.usage:
diec --json sample.exe | jq '.detects[].name' # Extract detected packers
diec --all --verbose malware.bin # Comprehensive analysis
diec --signature-scan --entropy trojan.exe # Combined signature and entropy
diec --db-stats # Display signature database statistics
diec --scan-time=30 large_binary.exe # Set scan timeout

diel.description: Lightweight packer detector optimized for speed over completeness
diel.usage:
diel --fast *.exe # Quick batch scanning mode
diel --basic-info --no-scan binary.dll # File info without deep analysis
diel --format=csv samples/ > results.csv # CSV output format
diel --quick-detect --exit-code packed.exe # Return exit code for scripts
diel --minimal-output suspicious.bin # Terse output for automation
